# uzc_virtual_routers (Data Source)

Lists UzCloud virtual routers.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "uzc_virtual_routers" "all" {}

output "virtual_router_slugs" {
  value = [for vr in data.uzc_virtual_routers.all.virtual_routers : vr.slug]
}
```
